newsitem.title: USA: Los Angeles spot prods firm in wake of Mobil fire.
newsitem.headline: Los Angeles spot prods firm in wake of Mobil fire.

text.p: U.S. West Coast refined product prices were a touch firmer at midday Friday as traders continued to assess effects of a fire late Thursday at Mobil's refinery in the Los Angeles area.
The fire, located in a coker at the 130,000 barrel per day refinery, is more likely to stimulate distillate prices than gasoline.

Federal-quality EPA-grade diesel for prompt delivery in Los Angeles stood a cent higher at between 68.50 and 69.50 cents a gallon, while prompt state-quality CARB-grade material was stable at between 71 and 72 cents a gallon.
Diesel prices in San Francisco meanwhile softened, with prompt CARB-grade and EPA-grade barrels both talked at between 66 and 67 cents a gallon.

Prompt regular conventional gasoline prices in Los Angeles firmed a cent to between 60.50 and 61.50 cents a gallon, as did prompt regular reformulated gasoline in Los Angeles to between 64 and 65 cents a gallon.
Jet fuel prices were stable in both centers at between 72 and 73 cents a gallon.
